messages:
Anna CSM: Heads up — Hightower (marketing) is spinning up 3 new squads and we just saw a ~6x embeddings QPS spike on EU this morning. Might need temporary dedicated capacity or routing tweaks. Anyone free to triage? :eyes:
Mike Solutions: Can you paste the QPS numbers + vector index size? Is this per-team or aggregate?
Anna CSM: Aggregate. Last 12h avg ~120 QPS -> ~720 QPS in the last 2h. Peak ~1.3k QPS in eu-west-1. Embedding dim 1536, index storage ~42GB. Dashboard: https://hightower.example/dash (they shared read-only link).
Raj Client Eng: Which model variant are they using and is it quantized? Any latency SLOs slipping?
Anna CSM: Using `mistral-embed-1536` (quantized int8). Median latency 180ms usually -> 420ms at peak. No hard SLO breaches yet but they saw increased batch failures and some 5xxs around peak.
Mike Solutions: Ok — two immediate options: (1) route traffic to a dedicated pool for the 24–72h ramp; (2) add burst nodes in eu. @eng-infra can you advise capacity?
eng-bot: /capacity-check --region eu-west-1 --window 72h
eng-bot: result: available spare: 0.5 nodes. Recommendation: request +2 nodes or fallback to us-west until pool freed.
Sophie AE: FYI renewal in ~6 weeks. If this pattern keeps, procurement will want a predictable committed plan. Suggest we propose a short dedicated pilot and show TCO.
Anna CSM: Agreed. Also their PM called out "production jitter" between 09:30–13:00 CET; capture for post-mortem. Can we schedule enablement for batching + caching best practices?
Raj Client Eng: I'll draft a terse runbook and a one-page playbook for Hightower. Quick config they can try immediately:
```
routing: {
  policy: region-priority,
  fallback: dedicated-eu-temp,
  batching: { max_tokens: 256, max_batch: 32 }
}
```
Mike Solutions: Tag me on the PR. I'll run a delta-cost estimate for 2-node burst vs dedicated 4-week pilot. Will include token/embedding unit math and expected hit to monthly spend.
Anna CSM: Action items: Anna — follow up with Hightower + schedule workshop; Raj — create runbook + paste into their workspace; Mike — cost estimate; Sophie — own renewal outreach. I'll loop in finance if pilot looks likely. :thumbsup:
Sophie AE: Noted. I'll book a 30-min sync with Hightower for tomorrow 10:00 CET and add renewals lead.
Anna CSM: Thanks everyone. I'll update thread with workshop invite and their PAM access. Closing once workshop scheduled. :calendar:
